# Friends Electricals & Plumbing

> South India's premier infrastructure supply partner and authorized wholesale distributor for high-grade electrical, plumbing, lighting, switchgear, and safety equipment.

Friends Electricals & Plumbing (headquartered in Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu) is a trusted B2B infrastructure material distributor supplying residential developments, industrial plants, government projects, healthcare facilities, and educational institutions across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

## Quick Facts & Business Highlights

- **Organization**: Friends Electricals & Plumbing (also operating as Friends Electricals)
- **Founder**: Alwin Vignesh
- **Established**: 2015 (Wholesale B2B expansion in 2018; Industrial division in 2021)
- **Headquarters**: 3 / 13-1 Main Road, Thiraviyapuram, Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu 628003, India
- **Warehouse Infrastructure**: 10,000+ sq ft centralized fulfillment center with critical spares inventory
- **Turnover & Reach**: ₹50Cr+ annual turnover; 500+ completed projects; 200+ active enterprise & corporate clients
- **Primary Website**: https://friendselectricals.store/
- **Digital Storefront**: https://friendselectricals.store/shop (Direct Self-Hosted E-Commerce with Cash on Delivery)
- **Direct Phone**: +91 78459 61669
- **Inquiry Email**: contact@friendselectricals.store
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 09:00 – 21:00 IST

---

## Core Value Propositions & Services

- **Site-Direct Logistics**: 24-hour dispatch for bulk orders across South India, coordinated with construction milestones.
- **Wholesale Tier Pricing**: Direct-from-manufacturer volume pricing on bulk orders (special tier pricing for projects exceeding ₹5 Lakhs).
- **Engineering & BOQ Consultation**: In-house technical assistance for Bill of Quantities (BOQ) estimation, electrical load calculations, and switchgear selection.
- **Audit-Compliant Documentation**: 100% compliant documentation for government and corporate tenders, including manufacturer test certificates, warranty guarantees, and batch inspection reports.
- **Critical Inventory Management**: Rapid delivery on emergency replacement parts, reducing industrial machinery and facility downtime.

---

## Authorized Brand Partnerships

Friends Electricals is an authorized dealer and wholesale distributor for industry-leading global and national manufacturers:

- **Cables & Wires**: Polycab, Finolex, Gloster
- **Switchgear & Automation**: Legrand, Schneider Electric, L&T (Larsen & Toubro), Havells
- **Piping & Plumbing**: Supreme Pipes, Ashirvad Pipes, Finolex
- **Motors, Pumps & Appliances**: Crompton, Havells

---

## Product Categories & Engineering Solutions

### 1. Industrial Cabling & Wiring
- **Armoured Power Cables**: Aluminium and copper XLPE-insulated cables (HT/LT) for underground, outdoor, and heavy industrial distribution.
- **Fire Survival & FRLS House Wires**: Fire Survival (FS), Flame Retardant Low Smoke (FRLS), and Zero Halogen (ZHFR) wires engineered to maintain circuit integrity during emergency fires.
- **Submersible Flat Cables**: High-durability 3-core flat rubber/PVC insulated cables for agricultural, borewell, and industrial pumping systems (1.5 sq mm to 50 sq mm).
- URL: https://friendselectricals.store/solutions/industrial-cabling-wiring

### 2. Switchgear & Panel Boards
- **Final Distribution**: MCBs (Miniature Circuit Breakers), RCCBs, RCBOs, Isolators, and Distribution Boards (DBs) for residential and commercial circuits.
- **Power Distribution**: MCCBs (Molded Case Circuit Breakers), ACBs (Air Circuit Breakers), and busbar trunking systems.
- **Motor Control**: Magnetic Contactors, Thermal Overload Relays (OLRs), and Motor Protection Circuit Breakers (MPCBs).
- **Industrial Automation**: Timers, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), digital energy meters, and industrial sensors.
- URL: https://friendselectricals.store/solutions/switchgear-panel-boards

### 3. Commercial & Industrial Lighting
- **High-Bay & Warehouse Fixtures**: High-lumen, energy-efficient LED luminaires designed for factories, warehouses, and logistics centers.
- **Hazardous & Flameproof Lighting**: Explosion-proof and weather-resistant fixtures certified for chemical plants and oil processing facilities.
- **Commercial & Cleanroom Lighting**: Recessed LED troffers, architectural downlights, and dust-proof cleanroom panels for corporate offices and hospitals.
- **Outdoor & Infrastructure**: Solar LED street lights, architectural facade illumination, and high-mast stadium lights.
- URL: https://friendselectricals.store/solutions/commercial-industrial-lighting

### 4. Earthing & Lightning Protection
- **Maintenance-Free Chemical Earthing**: Copper-bonded steel electrodes, GI chemical earthing rods, and high-performance Backfill Compound (BFC/earth enhancement material).
- **Advanced Lightning Arresters**: Early Streamer Emission (ESE) lightning terminals and conventional Faraday copper lightning conductors.
- **Grounding Accessories**: Copper and GI grounding flats, earth pit chambers, inspection pits, and exothermically welded joints.
- URL: https://friendselectricals.store/solutions/earthing-lightning-protection

### 5. Industrial Motors & Pumping Systems
- **Centrifugal & Monoblock Pumps**: High-efficiency water handling systems for commercial buildings, manufacturing lines, and process facilities.
- **Submersible Deep-Well Pumps**: Multi-stage stainless-steel borewell pumps for agriculture, municipal water supply, and dewatering.
- **Heavy Induction Motors**: High-torque 3-phase IE2/IE3 energy-efficient electric motors.
- **Pump Control & Automation**: Direct-On-Line (DOL) starters, Star-Delta control panels, and automated water-level controllers.
- URL: https://friendselectricals.store/solutions/industrial-motors-pumps

### 6. Plumbing, Drainage & Sanitary Piping
- **CPVC & UPVC Piping**: Supreme and Ashirvad hot and cold potable water distribution systems.
- **SWR Drainage Systems**: Soil, waste, and rainwater PVC piping with leak-proof ring-fit joints.
- **Industrial Valves & Hardware**: Brass, bronze, and CI gate valves, check valves, ball valves, and water storage tanks.

## Industry Verticals Served

- **Residential Developers & High-Rises**: Just-In-Time (JIT) material kitting aligned with building construction phases (conduiting, slab casting, wiring, finishing).
  - Link: https://friendselectricals.store/industries/residential-housing-supply
- **Industrial & Manufacturing Plants**: High-durability electrical infrastructure, automated panels, and critical MRO spares.
  - Link: https://friendselectricals.store/industries/industrial-factory-supply
- **Government & PWD Infrastructure**: Public works tenders, CPWD/PWD compliant technical specifications with OEM mill test certificates and warranty backing.
  - Link: https://friendselectricals.store/industries/government-tender-supplies
- **Hospitals & Medical Infrastructure**: Low Smoke Zero Halogen (LSZH) cabling, cleanroom lighting, isolated power supply protection, and 24/7 backup power components.
  - Link: https://friendselectricals.store/industries/hospital-medical-infrastructure
- **Educational Institutions & Campuses**: Energy-efficient campus lighting, hostel wiring, centralized water distribution, and low-maintenance earthing.
  - Link: https://friendselectricals.store/industries/school-college-maintenance
